method: BVH raycast of the front camera ray at a grid across each candidate vent mouth's outer face; the vent span is REMOVED from the BVH so a mouth never occludes itself. `proj` = visible fraction * cos(bearing), the share of a square-on mouth this bearing presents to the camera.
